hypotheses.subject: legacy-checkout-fallback
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag `legacy-checkout-fallback` was toggled from on to off at 15:07, rolling out during that minute (off 39 / on 161) and fully off from 15:08. Account page requests immediately began failing with ZeroDivisionError, driving the error rate from ~1% baseline to ~36%.

supporting_evidence.claim: 2026-09-12T15:07:00Z ERROR io-shop: account page request failed - ZeroDivisionError: division by zero
error_rate rises from 0.015 at 15:06 to 0.065 at 15:07 and 0.355 at 15:08, staying ~0.32-0.38
Every recorded change to io-shop from 2026-09-12T11:00:00Z to 2026-09-12T15:07:00Z. (nothing changed in this window)

hypotheses.summary: Alternative: a latent code defect in the non-fallback (new) checkout path was already deployed earlier and only became reachable when the flag turned off. No deploy appears in the 11:00-15:07 change window, so the flag flip is the proximate trigger regardless.
